summary: Euphorbia prostrata extract is a standardized herbal flavonoid-rich plant extract used mainly for the symptomatic treatment of hemorrhoids (bleeding, pain, swelling). It is thought to act as a phlebotonic/vasoprotective and anti-inflammatory agent that strengthens venous tone, reduces capillary fragility and limits inflammation in the anorectal vascular cushions. It is not FDA-approved and is marketed chiefly in India and some other countries as oral tablets, often as a short course.

moa: The extract is rich in flavonoids and polyphenols that are proposed to exert phlebotonic and vasoprotective actions: improving venous tone, reducing capillary permeability and fragility, and exerting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in the hemorrhoidal vascular plexus. This is thought to decrease bleeding, edema and pain. The precise molecular mechanism is not fully characterized.
